description: Source code for the Telemetry plugin in a WPEFramework-based project, implementing telemetry report management, privacy mode notifications, and event logging with support for IARM and RBUS inter-process communication.

classes.name: Telemetry
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry report handling, privacy mode notifications, and event logging with support for IARM and RBUS.

methods.name: setReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the report profile status based on input parameters, updating RFC parameters accordingly.

methods.name: logApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a name and value, sending it via telemetry.

methods.name: UploadReport
methods.description: Triggers an upload of the telemetry report via RBUS.

methods.name: AbortReport
methods.description: Aborts the ongoing telemetry report upload via RBUS.

methods.name: notifyT2PrivacyMode
methods.description: Notifies RBUS of the current privacy mode setting.

methods.name: onReportUploadStatus
methods.description: Handles the status of report upload, sending a notification.
